overview_description.description: TerraFirma develops software, autonomous robotics, and operational systems for earthworks and construction projects. Its platform supports construction planning, equipment orchestration, and job site operations using human-in-the-loop automation to improve excavation, grading, demolition, and other earthmoving activities. The company combines AI-enabled software with robotics to assist construction teams in managing equipment and workflows. It also develops technologies intended to expand into other construction processes, including underground utilities, concrete, and structural steel.
